description: This file defines an abstract class 'HTMLPurifier_URIFilter' which serves as a base for creating chainable URI filters in the HTMLPurifier library. It provides properties for filter identification and control flags, and declares methods for preparation and filtering of URIs.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIFilter
classes.description: An abstract base class for creating custom URI filters in the HTMLPurifier library. It supports configuration, transformation, and blacklisting of URIs during HTML purification.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Performs any necessary initialization for the filter; returns false if the filter should be considered inactive.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Abstract method that must be implemented to perform filtering on a URI object, influencing whether processing continues.
